import copy
import math
import unittest

from solution import decode_options


class DecodeOptionsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_decoding_overwrites_without_moving_first_position(self):
        options = [
            [" Alpha ", "enabled"],
            ["COUNT", "+12"],
            ["ratio", "1.25"],
            ["ALPHA", "DISABLED"],
            ["exp", "1e3"],
            ["negative_zero", "-0"],
        ]
        original = copy.deepcopy(options)
        result = decode_options(options)
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["alpha", "count", "ratio", "exp", "negative_zero"])
        self.assertEqual(
            result,
            {"alpha": False, "count": 12, "ratio": 1.25, "exp": 1000.0, "negative_zero": 0},
        )
        self.assertEqual(options, original)

    def test_values_are_not_trimmed_and_noncanonical_values_stay_strings(self):
        values = {
            "leading_zero": "01",
            "signed_leading_zero": "+01",
            "spaced_int": " 1",
            "spaced_word": " enabled ",
            "nan": "nan",
            "inf": "inf",
            "overflow": "1e309",
            "plain": "hello",
            "dot": ".5",
            "trailing_dot": "2.",
        }
        result = decode_options([[key, value] for key, value in values.items()])
        for key in ["leading_zero", "signed_leading_zero", "spaced_int", "spaced_word", "nan", "inf", "overflow", "plain"]:
            self.assertEqual(result[key], values[key])
            self.assertIsInstance(result[key], str)
        self.assertEqual(result["dot"], 0.5)
        self.assertEqual(result["trailing_dot"], 2.0)
        self.assertTrue(math.isfinite(result["dot"]))

    def test_unicode_name_casefolding(self):
        result = decode_options([[" Straße ", "1"], ["STRASSE", "2"]])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"strasse": 2})

    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_options([]), {})

    def test_invalid_shapes_and_types(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            decode_options(())
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            decode_options([("a", "1")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_options([["a"]])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_options([["a", "1", "extra"]])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            decode_options([[1, "value"]])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            decode_options([["name", 1]])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_options([[" \t ", "value"]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
